description: Concise offline definitions of terms used by the recommender, paraphrased from the supplied Voltaic Aim Glossary and Aim Journey guide.

terms.Accuracy: The proportion of attempted shots that hit a target.
terms.Anti-mirroring: Strafing opposite to the target, increasing the mouse correction required to stay on it.
terms.Benchmark: A standardized scenario used to assess current skill rather than teach it.
terms.Cheesing: Changing settings or behavior mainly to inflate a score instead of improving the intended skill.
terms.Click timing: Coordinating the shot with the moment the crosshair and target are correctly aligned.
terms.Clicking: Acquiring targets and eliminating them with one or more accurately timed clicks.
terms.Crosshair placement: Keeping the crosshair where a likely target can be engaged with minimal correction.
terms.Deliberate practice: Focused practice organized around a specific controllable improvement goal.
terms.Dynamic clicking: Clicking practice against moving targets that requires trajectory reading and timing.
terms.Evasive switching: Switching to targets whose movement must be read and tracked before they can be finished.
terms.Flick: A fast, controlled movement that brings the crosshair onto a target.
terms.Hit confirming: Briefly verifying alignment or tracking contact before committing the shot.
terms.Leading: Aiming ahead of a moving target to account for projectile travel time.
terms.Micro-correction: A small adjustment that finishes alignment after the initial movement.
terms.Mirroring: Strafing in the same direction as the target, reducing the mouse movement required to track it.
terms.Mouse control: Coordinating mouse, fingers, wrist, and arm to move the crosshair intentionally.
terms.Over-flicking: Passing beyond the target during the initial acquisition movement.
terms.Precise tracking: Maintaining smooth contact through small or continuous changes in target motion.
terms.Prediction: Guessing a future direction change instead of responding to visible movement.
terms.Reactive tracking: Responding quickly to abrupt direction changes and settling back onto the target.
terms.Reading: Interpreting the target's current position, speed, direction, and movement pattern.
terms.Routine: An ordered set of scenarios selected for broad development or a specific weakness.
terms.Scenario: A repeatable aim-training task with defined target behavior and scoring.
terms.Smoothness: Purposeful mouse movement without avoidable jitter or corrections.
terms.Static clicking: Clicking practice in which targets remain stationary.
terms.Strafe aiming: Coordinating player movement with the mouse correction needed to remain on target.
terms.Switching: Rapidly acquiring a new target and maintaining contact long enough to finish it.
terms.Tension: Excessive tightening of the hand, wrist, arm, or shoulder that interferes with control or comfort.
terms.Tracking: Keeping the crosshair on a moving target while responding to its changes.
terms.Trailing: Remaining behind a moving target instead of matching its current position.
terms.Under-flicking: Stopping the initial acquisition movement short of the target.
